cases.name: a single piece
a scale-out: one buy of 2, two sells, is one position
a scale-in: two buys closed by one sell, is one position
a re-entry after a full exit the same day is a second position
opened at the very instant of the latest close starts a new position; equal opens join
a joining piece extends the latest close, so a later open inside it still joins
a piece left to expire pays no closing fee
every piece expired
a piece closed on a later New York day
shares and short pieces are not positions
cost zero, a gap piece and a lot still open are flagged and left out
a held lot with no open time flags every position of its contract (the cautious reading)
fees on partial closes: a buy of 5 closed in three sells
an oversized entry closed in halves is one position of its whole cost
the New York day turns at local midnight, either side of a clock change
offsets and odd precision are read as the instant they name, in whole milliseconds
a journal that already carries fees takes none off
a tie on opened_at is ordered by id, so a zero-length lower id stands alone
a time without a zone is not read: the piece is skipped and a held lot so stamped flags its contract
zones written +0000 or +00, and basic-format times, are not read in either language
a long piece of a kind that is not an option or a share is left out, not filed as short
malformed entries are skipped
